description.original_author: openEHR Archetype Editorial Group / Ocean Informatics

details.purpose: Laboratory result specialised for histology reports. This allows a terminology driven approach using LOINC / SNOMED codes to specify the name of the elements, the value types being set at template level or runtime.
details.use: Will generally be used in combination with archetypes reprensenting other parts of the laboratory test ordering and processing process.
